name: cti_bench_mcq
description:
CTI-Bench: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ)
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains 2,500 multiple choice questions focused on cybersecurity knowledge, particularly based on the MITRE ATT&CK framework. It's part of the CTI-Bench suite for evaluating Large Language Models on Cyber Threat Intelligence tasks.

	
		
		Dataset Structure
	

Each example contains:

url: Source URL (typically MITRE ATT&CK technique pages)
question: The cybersecurity question
option_a: First… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/tuandunghcmut/cti_bench_mcq.
reputation: Part of the CTI-Bench suite for evaluating LLMs on Cyber Threat Intelligence tasks; used by researchers working on cybersecurity benchmarks but has limited mainstream adoption.
